apiName.title: Api Name
apiName.description: What kind of operation to perform

methodName.title: Method Name
methodName.description: What sub operation to use for the selected operation

enterpriseId.title: Enterprise Id
enterpriseId.description: The enterprise ID to use for an App Enterprise.

inBody.title: In Body
inBody.description: Sets the name of a parameter to be passed in the exchange In Body

userId.title: User Id
userId.description: The user ID to use for an App User.

exceptionHandler.title: Exception Handler
exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.title: Exchange Pattern
exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

lazyStartProducer.title: Lazy Start Producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

httpParams.title: Http Params
httpParams.description: Custom HTTP params for settings like proxy host

authenticationType.title: Authentication Type
authenticationType.description: The type of authentication for connection. Types of Authentication: STANDARD_AUTHENTICATION - OAuth 2.0 (3-legged) SERVER_AUTHENTICATION - OAuth 2.0 with JSON Web Tokens

accessTokenCache.title: Access Token Cache
accessTokenCache.description: Custom Access Token Cache for storing and retrieving access tokens.

encryptionAlgorithm.title: Encryption Algorithm
encryptionAlgorithm.description: The type of encryption algorithm for JWT. Supported Algorithms: RSA_SHA_256 RSA_SHA_384 RSA_SHA_512

maxCacheEntries.title: Max Cache Entries
maxCacheEntries.description: The maximum number of access tokens in cache.

privateKeyFile.title: Private Key File
privateKeyFile.description: The private key for generating the JWT signature.

privateKeyPassword.title: Private Key Password
privateKeyPassword.description: The password for the private key.

publicKeyId.title: Public Key Id
publicKeyId.description: The ID for public key for validating the JWT signature.

userName.title: User Name
userName.description: Box user name, MUST be provided

userPassword.title: User Password
userPassword.description: Box user password, MUST be provided if authSecureStorage is not set, or returns null on first call
